name: BP-SETUP-01 Phase 2 Validation
description: Manual validation for current Nebius structured-output roles and Pinecone integrated-embedding data-plane operations. Uses only synthetic test data and removes the Pinecone test record.

parameters.jsCode: const response=$input.first()?.json??{};const selected=$('Select Role Models').first().json;const responseModel=response.model??null;const role=responseModel===selected.fast_model?'FAST':(responseModel===selected.strong_model?'STRONG':(responseModel===selected.audit_model?'AUDIT':'UNKNOWN'));const model=responseModel??(role==='FAST'?selected.fast_model:(role==='STRONG'?selected.strong_model:selected.audit_model));let parsed=null;let errorClass=null;try{const content=response.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;if(!content)throw new Error(response.error?.message??'EMPTY_MODEL_OUTPUT');parsed=typeof content==='string'?JSON.parse(content):content;}catch(e){errorClass=e.message;}let valid=false;if(role==='FAST')valid=parsed?.route==='ASK_FOUNDER'&&Number.isFinite(parsed?.confidence);if(role==='STRONG')valid=['customer','problem','unknown'].every(k=>typeof parsed?.[k]==='string'&&parsed[k].length>0);if(role==='AUDIT')valid=parsed?.verdict==='NOT_SUPPORTED'&&typeof parsed?.reason==='string';return [{json:{provider:'Nebius',role,model,ok:valid,error_class:valid?null:(errorClass??'SCHEMA_ASSERTION_FAILED'),checked_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];

parameters.jsCode: const up=$('Pinecone Upsert Synthetic Evidence').first().json??{};const search=$('Pinecone Search Synthetic Evidence').first().json??{};const del=$input.first()?.json??{};const hits=search.result?.hits??search.hits??search.matches??[];const found=hits.some(h=>(h._id??h.id)==='bp-phase2-record-1');const upOk=!up.error;const searchOk=!search.error&&found;const deleteOk=!del.error;return [{json:{provider:'Pinecone',upsert_ok:upOk,search_ok:searchOk,delete_ok:deleteOk,ok:upOk&&searchOk&&deleteOk,matched_record:found,namespace:'bp-phase2-smoke',checked_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
